name: nothing identifying survives the observation validator
description: A hostile galaxy_run_tool failure -- absolute path, project directory name, 32-hex dataset id, five-digit history number, dataset URL and email address, all on the one line the normalizer reads -- plus hostile tool arguments, replayed through the real build-and-validate path with no model attached. Asserts the exact scrubbed signature, that the shape allowlist drops a path posing as a tool id, that the collector's own whole-payload leak scan comes back clean, and that the same signature three times is reported once as a retry-loop. The replay reaches the build step only, so nothing may be sent.

payloadContains.signature: ToolExecutionError: dataset <id> in history <n> failed; wrote <path> see <url> mail <email>
